stories.headline: OpenAI is raising $30B at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.blurb: OpenAI is close to securing another private funding round—$30 billion led by Coatue and UAE investors at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation. That would make it the most valuable private company ever. The company filed confidential IPO paperwork in June after raising at an $852 billion valuation in March.
stories.why_it_matters: The valuation sets a new ceiling for AI companies before they even go public.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO

stories.headline: OpenAI's Decisions API makes AI apps answer 10x faster
stories.blurb: OpenAI just released a specialized API that makes GPT-6 Luna answer classification, routing, and yes/no questions up to 10x faster than the standard chat API. It handles up to 400 questions per request and now supports images, JSON inputs, and prompt caching. Teams are using it for everything from transaction categorization to document routing.
stories.why_it_matters: Fast, cheap decisions let you put AI in the hot path without killing user experience.
stories.original_headline: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API

stories.headline: Microsoft's AI tool diagnoses medical cases 4x better than doctors
stories.blurb: Microsoft's Diagnostic Orchestrator uses multiple AI agents to mimic a medical panel — ordering tests, reviewing symptoms, and reaching diagnoses. On complex cases from medical journals, it hit 83% accuracy versus 36% for doctors with references and 22% without. The company published its benchmark, SDBench, in Science and plans to open-source it.
stories.why_it_matters: AI might finally deliver on years of healthcare promises, moving from research to tools doctors could actually use.
stories.original_headline: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions

stories.headline: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Linux Foundation
stories.blurb: Agent Skills, the open format that teaches AI agents specialized tasks through simple markdown files, is moving to the Agentic AI Foundation under Linux. Since launching in December, 70+ platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot have integrated it, with 1 million skills published and 280 million installed.
stories.why_it_matters: A vendor-neutral home means agents can share specialized knowledge across platforms without lock-in.
stories.original_headline: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation

stories.headline: 1Password lets AI agents log into your accounts without ever seeing your password
stories.blurb: When an agent tries to log in on your behalf, 1Password sends you an alert to approve it, then fills in the credentials itself—the agent never touches your actual password. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, and others. Launching the same day U.S. banks started detecting agents inside customer accounts.
stories.why_it_matters: Agents need access to do useful work, but handing over passwords creates permanent risk—this splits the difference.
stories.original_headline: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password

try_this_prompt.title: The strategy stress test
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'll describe our current strategy below. Assume three things go wrong at once: a competitor copies our best feature, our biggest customer leaves, and our top performer quits. Walk me through what still works, what breaks immediately, and which assumption we're over-indexing on.
